profile.headline: Project Engineer
profile.summary:
Graduated from University of Wisconsin Platteville with a Computer Science degree in December of 2022. Throughout my years of experience at school, I have gained great programming and team building skills. 

Current Software Test Engineer in the Aerospace Industry.

positions.title: Food Production Manger
positions.description: Prep professional standard food for weddings and other catering events. I also cook and prep food for college students and train new employees.

positions.title: Computer Science Intern
positions.description: I Shadowed a .NET programmer in making a C# MVC program, built python scripts, filled out e – commerce robot log form, took apart robots and examined for errors.
